transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because my body just feels completely drained. It's like... even just walking from my car into the clinic today, or being at work and just trying to open the EHR... it takes everything I have right now.
Over the past couple of weeks, how has your mood been? Have you been feeling sad, down, or empty?

Yeah, mostly just... empty. It's like, after all that energy I had just suddenly dropped, I've been feeling really down. Hopeless, I guess. Most days I just sit there feeling like I've already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.
When did you first start noticing this extreme fatigue and the drop in energy you mentioned?

Well, the really exhausted, depressed part... the feeling guilty and just completely drained... that's been going on for about nine months now. It started right after I crashed from that period where I had all that energy.
You mentioned crashing from a period where you had a lot of energy. During that time before the crash, how long did that period of high energy last, and what was your mood like during it?

That period lasted for a few weeks, I think. As for my mood... it was kind of a mix. Some days I felt amazing, just completely unstoppable, like I could do anything. But then... if someone at work corrected my documentation or told me I needed to slow down, I would just snap at them. I'd get so angry, like they were insulting me personally. It was just... really intense.
During those few weeks when you felt amazing and unstoppable, how much sleep were you getting each night, and did you feel like you needed less sleep than usual?

During that time, I was barely sleeping at all. Maybe... two or three hours a night, tops. But I didn't feel tired. I actually felt totally wired, like I didn't need sleep at all to keep going. 

But lately, with how I've been feeling these past months, it's completely different. Sometimes I wake up way before the sun's even up, just feeling sick to my stomach with worry. Other times, I end up sleeping through half the day, and even then, I still wake up feeling completely exhausted.

Before that few-week period of high energy that you mentioned, had you ever experienced other times in your life when you felt similarly energized, needed very little sleep, and felt like you could do anything?

No, not really. Um... I don't think I've ever had anything like that before. I mean, I've had normal days where I felt good, but never where I just stopped needing sleep or felt... unstoppable like that. That few-week period was definitely the first time it ever got that extreme.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F32.9 (Major Depressive Disorder). Patient clearly describes a distinct manic/hypomanic episode (few weeks of decreased need for sleep, grandiosity, irritability, increased goal-directed activity) followed by a depressive crash lasting 9 months. This bipolar presentation with one clear elevated episode followed by depression is diagnostic for Bipolar Disorder. The absence of prior episodes does not rule out bipolar disorder - first episodes can occur in adulthood.
